surela-tradex-ai.seoDescription: Surela Tradex AI claims AI analysis and fast payouts. This review checks each claim against the platform own pages.
surela-tradex-ai.deck: Surela Tradex AI claims AI analysis does the work. The pages also carry placeholders, conflicting lists and claims nobody verifies.

intro: Surela Tradex AI arrives with the familiar pitch: AI analysis, automatic entries, a US$250 start and a practice account. The pitch is polished. The fine print is where the questions begin, and that is what this review measures.
The setup is the segment standard: a web dashboard, AI-generated signals, 11 crypto assets through broker partners, and a US$250 minimum deposit with a demo account included.

We graded Surela Tradex AI on the same five dimensions as every review on this site: ease of use, features, transparency, security and support. The number below is ours, and the evidence sits in the sections above it.
whatItClaims: A US$250 minimum deposit to start.
Free registration, with account activation by confirmation link.
Risk settings adjustable before the first live trade.
A partner broker holding funds and executing orders.
Withdrawals processed in under a day, per the page.
whatWeChecked: The geo-restrictions: two lists on the page that do not agree.
The template marks: unfilled placeholders left in the wording.
The performance story: no verified track record behind the return claims.
The number reuse: one score figure doing more than one job.
The deposit terms: minimum amount, payment methods and where the money sits.
The demo claim: practice account confirmed in the signup flow.

steps.title: Register
steps.text: Complete the short signup form and click the confirmation link in your inbox.

steps.title: Fund
steps.text: Complete the US$250 deposit to unlock the live dashboard.

steps.title: Configure
steps.text: Configure the risk settings and mode, and keep the demo open while the live account warms up.

pros: Fast setup - minutes to a live dashboard.
Free registration and a demo account.
cons: Marketing numbers that the fine print walks back.
No independent audit of the models.
redFlags: A score and a community mood wearing the same number.
Support figures that contradict each other.
Template placeholders left unrendered.

faqs.q: How much support does it offer?
faqs.a: Unclear - around-the-clock coverage is claimed, while other sections quote different figures. Ask support to reconcile them before you fund anything.

faqs.q: Is it really fee-free?
faqs.a: The platform fee is absent, but every trade carries a broker spread the page itself calls the real cost. The headline says free; the fine print says otherwise. Budget for the fine print.

faqs.q: Is Surela Tradex AI safe, legit or a scam?
faqs.a: We found no scam indicators in the product, which reads as a functioning AI trading service. The conditions are editorial: claims without verification, conflicting figures and restriction lists that disagree. We rate it safe to research with the conditions in this review.

faqs.q: What happens after I sign up?
faqs.a: You confirm the account by email, fund US$250, set your risk preferences and choose automatic or manual mode. The demo account runs alongside while you learn.

faqs.q: What is the minimum deposit?
faqs.a: US$250, funded by bank card, bank transfer, PayPal or Skrill. It is trading capital in your balance, not a fee - and it is exposed to market risk once live.

bottomLine: The platform itself is workable - the dashboard, the demo and the two trading modes are all present. The caution applies to the claims around them, not the mechanics.

The score reflects the page: claims without verification, figures that conflict and restriction lists that disagree. Use the demo, deposit the minimum, and keep your own numbers - the page cannot be trusted with its own.
